title: Which organ pumps blood around your body?
explanation: The heart pumps blood.

title: How many bones are in a typical adult human skeleton?
explanation: Most adults have 206 bones.

title: I bend and straighten your arm, and I sit between your shoulder and wrist. Who am I?
explanation: The elbow is the joint in the middle of the arm.

title: 🦴🦵 Which joint is between the thigh and lower leg?
explanation: The knee joins the thigh and lower leg.

title: 💣 You have a sprained ankle. What is a sensible first step?
explanation: Stop the activity and assess the injury.

title: Ya zalame, iza 3am yewja3ak dahrek, min byese3dak bel rehabilitation?
explanation: A physiotherapist can help with movement and rehabilitation.

title: Which muscle mainly straightens the knee?
explanation: The quadriceps extends the knee.

title: 🔔 Which body system carries messages between brain and muscles?
explanation: Nerves carry signals.

title: I connect muscle to bone. What am I?
explanation: Tendons connect muscles to bones.

title: 🫁 What do these organs help you do?
explanation: Lungs help exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide.

title: Which is generally an aerobic activity?
explanation: Brisk walking can train aerobic fitness.

title: Chou ya3ne “3adale” bel English?
explanation: 3adale means muscle.

title: What is the main function of ligaments?
explanation: Ligaments connect bone to bone.

title: 💣 Someone feels dizzy during exercise. Best action?
explanation: Stop exercise and seek help.

title: 🧠 Which organ controls voluntary movement?
explanation: The brain coordinates voluntary movement.

title: I am the largest bone in the human body. Who am I?
explanation: The femur is the largest bone.

title: What does ROM mean in physiotherapy?
explanation: ROM stands for range of motion.

title: Iza rekbetak 3am touja3ak bel football, chou a7san ta3mol?
explanation: Stop painful activity and inform a responsible adult.

title: What does the Achilles tendon connect?
explanation: The Achilles tendon attaches calf muscles to the heel.

title: 🦶 Which part of the body contains the heel?
explanation: The heel is part of the foot.

title: 🔔 Which muscle helps bend your elbow?
explanation: Biceps brachii helps flex the elbow.

title: I cushion the ends of bones in many joints. What am I?
explanation: Articular cartilage helps smooth joint movement.

title: What is balance training useful for?
explanation: Balance training helps postural control.

title: Chou bya3mol l physio?
explanation: Physiotherapists help restore movement and function.

title: 💣 After a fall, a scout cannot stand and has severe pain. What should friends do?
explanation: Avoid moving them unnecessarily and get help.

title: 🦴 Which structure protects the brain?
explanation: The skull surrounds and protects the brain.

title: I am a muscle that helps you breathe and sits below your lungs. Who am I?
explanation: The diaphragm is the main breathing muscle.

title: How many chambers does a human heart have?
explanation: The heart has four chambers.

title: Ya 3amme, iza 3andak “tashannoj” ba3d l sport, chou a7san?
explanation: Rest and hydration can help with common exercise cramps.

title: 🏆 FINAL BOSS: Which statement best describes physiotherapy?
explanation: Physiotherapy supports movement, function and recovery.
